name: Diabetic Equipment And Supplies
old_description: Regardless of whether you live with Type 1 Diabetes or Type 2 Diabetes one thing remains…when you don’t have your supplies it is stressful and can be dangerous. We understand the critical nature of insulin pumps, CGMs and glucometers and it impacts everything we do.
about:
Diabetic Equipment and Supplies operates from Johnston, Iowa, with an additional location in Indiana, serving customers across 26 states. The company focuses exclusively on providing diabetes management equipment and supplies to individuals living with Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes.

The business distributes insulin pumps, continuous glucose monitors (CGMs), glucometers, and related supplies. Its service model assigns each patient a dedicated Patient Care Coordinator who manages the entire process from initial order through ongoing resupply. Coordinators handle insurance verification and billing for Medicaid, Medicare, and commercial plans, and the company waives shipping fees on resupply orders.

Customers include patients directly, as well as endocrinologists, healthcare providers, diabetes educators, and other medical professionals who refer or coordinate care. The coordinators work solely with diabetes products and insurance processes, providing specialized support rather than general medical supply distribution.

The company emphasizes relationship-based service: patients work with a single point of contact, avoid automated phone systems, and receive proactive outreach for resupply via phone, text, or email with personal follow-up if needed.
